pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-polygonal dark regions with low-frequency edge curvature and soft pixel-level gradients. Spatial area of patches decreases from the mid-neck toward the dorsal and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light pathways forming a continuous network. Topological nodes are primarily Y-junctions with thickness remaining relatively uniform across the shoulder.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dorsal mane displays a regular, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of hair tuft peaks is high and spatially consistent along the visible neck line.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A single significant silhouette irregularity is observed on the upper neck where a dark, protruding mass overlaps and breaks the linear profile of the mane.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized region of anomalous dark texture is present on the upper shoulder ridge. A prominent vertical linear furrow is visible on the mid-lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical linear mark or deep skin fold on the lateral flank. Two dark, non-pelage masses are localized on the upper ridge and center flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two exogenous dark-bodied masses with avian morphology, positioned on the dorsal neck ridge and the lateral flank.
